observations.official_streaming_execution_semantics: For every completed chunk, Qwen3-ASR appends PCM into audio_accum and re-feeds all audio accumulated from the beginning of the current stream to the model. Previous decoded text is used as a prompt prefix with token rollback after the configured unfixed period.
observations.existing_rollback_semantics: token-prefix rollback within one stream, not rollback of an internal acoustic/model cache across conversational turns

directly_testable_on_official_qwen_wrapp: bounded PCM/audio-history carry-over by explicit wrapper policy
not_directly_equivalent_on_official_qwen: carry-over of the paper's internal streaming acoustic/model state
rollback to a previously saved neural streaming state
transfer_result.consequence: Do not label a future Qwen3-ASR experiment as a reproduction of State Carry-over/State Rollback from arXiv:2608.22101 unless the runtime exposes and manipulates equivalent internal streaming model state. Treat official-wrapper experiments as QWEN_TEXT_AUDIO_CONTEXT_CONTINUITY variants instead.
transfer_result.higher_fidelity_route: Use a streaming ASR implementation with explicit persistent neural/cache state and snapshot/rollback semantics, or extend/replace the Qwen streaming path with a causal/cache-bearing implementation whose state identity can be captured and restored.

hypothesis: Qwen3-ASR can benefit from bounded cross-turn continuity, but the official vLLM streaming wrapper's audio/text accumulation is not mechanism-equivalent to internal-state rollback studied in stateful streaming transducer ASR.
counterhypotheses: The vLLM/model layer may maintain hidden reusable caches not surfaced by qwen_asr.py; source inspection of the public wrapper alone does not prove absence below the wrapper boundary.
Text/audio-history continuity may recover most practical onset gains even without internal neural-state rollback.
A causal Qwen3-ASR streaming variant may expose the missing state and make a higher-fidelity transfer possible.
